title: PulseSync
subtitle: Real-time Sync Platform
overview: Advanced multi-module Android application demonstrating senior-level architecture, Firebase backend, and offline-first design with real-time conflict resolution.
architecture: Clean Architecture with feature-first modularization. Each feature is an independent module with its own data, domain, and presentation layers.
challenges: Real-time conflict resolution for offline edits
Optimizing cold start times in multi-module app
Managing state across complex data flows
solutions: Used Baseline Profiles and lazy loading
Adopted MVI pattern for predictable state management

title: MoekyawTranslator
subtitle: AI-Powered Translation
overview: An intelligent translation application leveraging on-device AI with TensorFlow Lite and Cloud APIs for seamless multilingual communication.
architecture: MVVM with Repository pattern. Uses TFLite for on-device inference and Firebase ML for cloud-based fallback.
solutions: Quantized TFLite models for faster inference

title: Portfolio 2026
